columns.name: paired_gene_highest_expression_correlation_score
columns.description: The paired gene with the highest expression correlation score, with ties broken by the ascending order of the geneid

columns.name: located_in_cytoplasm_and_have_7_chromosomes
columns.description: Set to 1 if the gene is located in the cytoplasm and has 7 chromosomes, otherwise, set to 0. Located in the cytoplasm refers to classification.localization = 'cytoplasm'.

columns.name: paired_gene_lowest_expression_correlation_score
columns.description: The paired gene with the lowest expression correlation score, with ties broken by the ascending order of the geneid

columns.name: interaction_with_genes_located_in_the_nucleus_and_is_positively_correlated
columns.description: set to 1 if the gene's interaction is with genes located in the nucleus in which it is positively correlated. Locate in the nucleus refers to classification.localization = 'nucleus'.

columns.name: num_functions
columns.description: The number of functions the gene has, replace NULL values with 0.
